timing_policy: Isolated single-process attempts; all native construction and validation included, no retries. No controlled timing medians. Import, export, analysis and process time are separate; not additive native stage costs where nested.
memory_policy: Peak process observations after meshing and after analysis are separate from modeled working admission limits; neither is a hard operating-system memory cap.
size_policy: Unique Euclidean boundary triangle chord lengths in mm; not geodesic lengths or strict sizing certificates. Requested and native-effective controls retained separately.
fixture_scope: Owned repository fixtures; the broader fixture group is not an unseen generalization set.
snapshot_policy: Phase1 is an exploratory intermediate compiled snapshot, identified by binary and key source-file hashes, without a standalone source commit. Phase2 is the studied allocation implementation identified by its retained source-file hashes. The final source can reproduce the final route; exact Phase1 reproduction requires its retained working snapshot.

phase1.purpose: Expose and couple explicit construction caps; Legacy/no overrides preserves original path; no fair source/bulk reservations.

phase2.purpose: Add bounded adaptive estimates and fair source/bulk/closure allocation for opt-in non-Legacy policies.

metric_conventions.edge_median: arithmetic mean of the third and fourth of six sorted edge lengths
metric_conventions.mean_ratio: 12*(3*V)^(2/3)/sum(six squared edges) for positive orientation; otherwise zero
metric_conventions.minimum_dihedral_deg: minimum of six interior dihedral angles, in degrees; null for degeneracy
metric_conventions.orientation: sign of dot(cross(p1-p0,p2-p0),p3-p0); zero is degenerate
metric_conventions.range_limited: a nonzero measurement could not be represented as a finite nonzero binary64 value
metric_conventions.scaled_jacobian: sqrt(2)*signed determinant / maximum of four incident edge-length products
metric_conventions.scope: Tet4 shape only; no CAD, connectivity, overlap, or simulation certificate
metric_conventions.signed_volume: signed determinant / 6, in input length units cubed
metric_conventions.volume_equivalent_edge: edge of a regular tetrahedron of equal absolute volume
